newsitem.title: UK: UK hunt for oil at highest in six years - consultant.
newsitem.headline: UK hunt for oil at highest in six years - consultant.

text.p: The search for oil in the U.K. is at its highest level for six years, said consultants Arthur Andersen Petroleum Services Group.
There were 36 exploration and appraisal (E and A) oil wells drilled in in the first quarter this year, the highest level since the first quarter of 1991, Arthur Andersen said in a report.
Compared with the first quarter 1996 exploration wells were down 8 percent but appraisals were three times higher, they said.
Three of the wells made new discoveries and a further two finds from 1996 wells were revealed.
The report said E and A activity in Northwest Europe - which combines Norway, the Netherlands and Denmark - is at its highest level since 1992 and has almost doubled since last year.
Three Norwegian finds were made in the first quarter and two were made in the Netherlands.
The report noted that the U.K. had offered the 17th round of licenses on the U.K. continental shelf and had offered three further blocks in two different areas in "out-of-round" procedures.
